chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “Give charity and set out on whichever day you wish.”

key_terms.تَصَدَّقْ: Give charity as an act of devotion and protection
key_terms.وَاخْرُجْ: Set out or depart for travel
key_terms.يَوْمٍ: A day or time of departure

ai.seo_question: Can you begin a journey on any day if you give charity first?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs a person to give charity before beginning a journey. It indicates that charity is a recommended means of seeking blessing and protection, and that one may depart on any day after doing so.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2404 - It is narrated by Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abdul Rahman ibn Al-Hajjaj that
Abu Abdullah (as) said: "Give charity and then set out on your journey on any day you wish."
